points: Yirmiyahu is now in Mitzrayim, and he goes city to city telling all the Jews there, men and women, that they are doing wrong.
First, they moved to Mitzrayim, which the Torah forbids. There are different views on what exactly the prohibition covers.
Second, they are serving idols. They answer: we tried not serving idols under Yoshiyahu and it didn't work; when we served idols, life was good.
Yirmiyahu says repentance takes time, like paying off a huge debt, and theirs wasn't sincere. Most of all, Hashem is not a vending machine where you put in mitzvos and get rewards.
Only a few will survive. Rashi brings a midrash that it was Yirmiyahu and Baruch. Some say Baruch went to Bavel and taught Ezra, planting seeds for the future.
